rationale: In `app/public/app.js`, `render()` binds the delete button to `deleteTodo(i)` where `i` is the index within the filtered `visibleTodos()` array, and `deleteTodo(index)` splices the unfiltered `todos` array at `index`. When a filter hides preceding items, the filtered index diverges from the unfiltered array index and deletes the wrong todo. Updating `deleteTodo` to accept the todo `id` (matching `toggleTodo(id)`) and filtering `todos` by `id` ensures the clicked item is removed regardless of active filters.
other_bugs_noticed: In app/server.js, the PATCH /api/todos/:id handler compares numeric `t.id` against string `req.params.id` with strict equality (`===`), causing todo completion state changes to return 404 and revert when the user reloads the page.

In app/public/index.html, `.title` has `white-space: nowrap` without overflow handling, so long todo titles push the delete button off the right edge of the `overflow: hidden` list item and make it unclickable.
